name: Family Reunification Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor must have resided lawfully in Cyprus for at least 2 years and hold a residence permit valid for at least 1 year with reasonable prospect of more permanent residence (exceptions apply for certain researcher/intra-corporate-transferee sponsors).
The spouse must be at least 21 years old and the marriage must have been celebrated at least 1 year before the application.

The sponsor must show stable and regular resources sufficient to maintain the family without relying on social assistance, suitable accommodation, and health insurance covering the sponsor and family members.
Requires being the unmarried minor child (including adopted) of the sponsor or the sponsor's spouse, with the sponsor holding sole custody and responsibility for maintenance.

evidence_required.document: Proof of sponsor's stable income and suitable accommodation
Health insurance for sponsor and family members

sources.title: Lawyers in Cyprus -- Family Reunification in Cyprus (sponsor and family-member requirements)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build. This transposes the EU Family Reunification Directive into Cyprus's own statutory procedure -- the source explicitly notes parents and other relatives do NOT ordinarily qualify under this procedure (a real, worth-flagging limitation, unlike some other countries' broader family-tie lists in this dataset).
